facts.fact: Capital FM reports that Immaculate Kassait is the outgoing Data Commissioner after six years leading Kenya's Office of the Data Protection Commissioner.
facts.system: Office of the Data Protection Commissioner (ODPC)

facts.fact: The outgoing Data Commissioner says the ODPC assesses complaints, investigates alleged breaches and sets penalties by repeat offending, seriousness, number affected and remedy, and has issued guidance on artificial intelligence; no named decision or count is given.
facts.system: Office of the Data Protection Commissioner (ODPC)
